value.name: group leaves limo and heads home
value.description: After arriving, everyone walks away from the limo with their suitcases, splitting off toward their destinations.
evidence: Everyone walking away from the limo, suitcases in hand.
Micky heading for his shitty car parked on the street, Dicky walking to Alice's house with his mother and father.

value.name: Dicky says goodbye to Micky
value.description: Dicky calls out to Micky and tells him they will talk tomorrow.
evidence: DICKY (calls out to Micky) Take care, Mick, we'll talk tommorrah.

value.name: Little Dicky greets his father
value.description: Little Dicky runs out of the house and jumps into Dicky's arms, prompting an affectionate greeting.
evidence: Little Dicky runs out of the house into Dicky's arms.

value.name: Little Dicky asks if Micky won
value.description: Little Dicky asks whether Uncle Micky won the fight, and Dicky admits he did not.
evidence: LITTLE DICKY Did Uncle Micky win?
DICKY Not this time, Dicky, try and gimme a sock in the nose--

value.name: Micky doubts continuing boxing
value.description: Watching Dicky with his son, Micky says he does not think he wants to fight anymore.
evidence: Micky, lost in thought, stands at his car watching Dicky playing with Little Dicky.
MICKY Nah, I don't think I wanna do this no more.
value.location_hint: street outside Alice & George Ward's house

value.name: Alice promises another fight
value.description: Alice reassures Micky that they will get him another fight and urges him not to quit.
evidence: ALICE (TO MICKY) We'll get you anothah fight, Micky.
ALICE Listen to your bruthah, honey, they owe us big time.

value.name: Dicky insists ESPN owes them
value.description: Dicky argues that ESPN screwed them and says they deserve another fight once Micky heals up.
evidence: DICKY ESPN screwed us, they owe us. We'll get anothah fight. Just get healed up, Micky, you're okay -

value.name: Alice suggests Dicky comeback fight
value.description: Alice pushes the idea that they could even arrange a comeback fight for Dicky as well.
evidence: Maybe they could even do Dicky's comeback fight too.

value.name: Micky silently agrees
value.description: Micky responds only with a nod, accepting the others' encouragement without speaking.

value.name: Micky leaves in his car
value.description: After Dicky pats him on the back, Micky gets into his car to go.
evidence: Dicky pats him on the back as Micky gets into his car.
value.location_hint: street outside Alice & George Ward's house

value.name: George defends Micky
value.description: George tells Alice that Micky has been through a lot, pushing back against her pressure.
evidence: GEORGE Christ, Alice, he's been through the wringah -

value.name: Alice snaps at George and O'Keefe
value.description: Alice angrily challenges George and then turns on O'Keefe, asking what his problem is.
evidence: ALICE What're you talkin' about? (to O'Keefe who's staring AT HER) - And what's your fuckin' problem?

value.name: Mickey O'Keefe walks away
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe shakes his head and leaves the confrontation.
evidence: Mickey O'Keefe shakes his head and walks away.
